breaking.change: Forced colours mode is gone. `Viewport.forcedColors` is removed, the web shell no longer reads the page's `(forced-colors: active)`, documents' colours are never forced, and `forced-color-adjust` is refused by name. `(forced-colors: none)` always matches and `(forced-colors: active)` never does, as before the mode was added.
breaking.fix: Stop setting `forcedColors` on a viewport. Give players contrast through the style pack and `(prefers-contrast: more)` instead.
